description: Responsible AI signal detection rules for Mamoru

rules.description: Detects explicit disclosure of AI use in content creation or systems

confidenceRules.HIGH: Multiple clear AI disclosures or AI tool name prominently featured
confidenceRules.MEDIUM: Single clear disclosure or combination of weak signals
confidenceRules.LOW: Ambiguous mention of automation or algorithmic content

falsePositives: Page discussing AI without being AI-generated
Use of 'intelligent' in product marketing
References to AI in historical or fictional context

rules.description: Detects transparency about how AI systems work or make decisions

confidenceRules.HIGH: Detailed explanation of AI decision-making with specific methodology or factors
confidenceRules.MEDIUM: General transparency statement with some specific details
confidenceRules.LOW: Vague mention of transparency or algorithm without concrete explanation

falsePositives: Marketing copy claiming transparency without proof
Explanation of non-AI automation
Dense technical discussion without clarity

rules.description: Detects disclosure of how personal data is collected and used by AI systems

confidenceRules.HIGH: Clear specific privacy disclosure tied to AI data practices
confidenceRules.MEDIUM: Privacy policy mentions data use but connection to AI is unclear or weak
confidenceRules.LOW: General privacy statement without specific AI context

falsePositives: Generic privacy policy unrelated to AI
Mention of data without AI connection
Cookie disclosure unrelated to AI systems

rules.description: Detects acknowledgment of or testing for fairness and bias in AI systems

confidenceRules.HIGH: Detailed fairness analysis with specific metrics, testing data, or demographic breakdowns
confidenceRules.MEDIUM: Acknowledgment of fairness concerns with some documented mitigation efforts
confidenceRules.LOW: General fairness commitment without concrete evidence or testing

falsePositives: Use of 'diversity' without fairness testing connection
Discussion of fairness in non-AI context
Marketing claim of fairness without evidence

rules.description: Detects human oversight, accountability mechanisms, or appeal processes for AI decisions

confidenceRules.HIGH: Clear human oversight with documented process and user-accessible appeals mechanism
confidenceRules.MEDIUM: Mentioned oversight but lacking specifics or easy user access to appeals
confidenceRules.LOW: General accountability statement without concrete oversight mechanisms

falsePositives: General customer service mention unrelated to AI oversight
Mention of responsible AI without actual oversight mechanism
Human involvement in non-AI product areas

rules.description: Detects signs of AI-driven manipulation or covert algorithmic practices without disclosure

confidenceRules.HIGH: Pattern of personalization/recommendation without explanation or user choice
confidenceRules.MEDIUM: Personalization present with some disclosure or user control available
confidenceRules.LOW: Personalization signals present but insufficient evidence of deception or manipulation

falsePositives: Any personalization (which can be beneficial)
Mention of targeting in marketing context
General recommendation features that are transparent

rules.description: Detects AI-generated or AI-driven conclusions presented without supporting evidence or methodology

confidenceRules.HIGH: AI claim or statistic with no supporting evidence, methodology, or sources cited
confidenceRules.MEDIUM: Some evidence or methodology provided but incomplete or unclear
confidenceRules.LOW: Well-supported claim with clear methodology and evidence references

falsePositives: Complex but actually well-supported claims
Legitimate research presented clearly but densely
Academic writing with assumed reader knowledge

rules.description: Detects indicators that content may be AI-generated without disclosure

confidenceRules.HIGH: Clear disclosure of AI generation OR obvious generated content with no disclosure
confidenceRules.MEDIUM: Possible AI generation with weak signals or disclosure present but unclear
confidenceRules.LOW: Ambiguous indicators, could be human-written with certain style

falsePositives: Well-written human content that appears AI-like
Discussion of AI without being AI-generated
Formal writing style confused with AI generation
